name: w4a16_q6_k_fp32_n4096_k4096
description: General matrix multiply (GEMM) C = A @ B.T. Captured from high-quality quantization deployments - Q6_K for near-FP32 quality (hidden_size=4096).

K.description: Input features (must be multiple of 256 for Q6_K)

weight.description: Q6_K quantized weight with 6-bit values and nested scales

block_q6_K.note: Q6_K: 6-bit values stored as 4-bit ql + 2-bit qh

reference:
import torch
import struct

def dequantize_q6_k_block(block_bytes, k=256):
    """Dequantize Q6_K block to k float values"""
    d = struct.unpack('<e', block_bytes[:2])[0]
    
    # Q6_K has complex structure
    scales = block_bytes[2:6]    # 4 bytes of scales (6-bit each)
    ql = block_bytes[6:134]     # 128 bytes of low 4 bits
    qh = block_bytes[134:166]   # 32 bytes of high 2 bits
    
    values = []
    for i in range(k):
        sub_block_idx = i // 64
        scale = (scales[sub_block_idx // 2] >> (6 * (sub_block_idx % 2))) & 0x3F
        scale_factor = (scale / 63.0) * d
        
        ql_val = (ql[i // 2] >> (4 * (i % 2))) & 0x0F
        qh_val = (qh[i // 4] >> (2 * (i % 4))) & 0x03
        q = (qh_val << 4) | ql_val
        
        val = scale_factor * (q / 64.0)
        values.append(val)
    
    return torch.tensor(values, dtype=torch.float32)

@torch.no_grad()
def run(activation, weight):
    M, K = activation.shape
    N = weight.shape[0]
    num_blocks = K // 256
    
    weight_dequant = torch.zeros(N, K, dtype=torch.float32)
    for n in range(N):
        for b in range(num_blocks):
            block_values = dequantize_q6_k_block(weight[n, b])
            weight_dequant[n, b*256:(b+1)*256] = block_values
    
    output = torch.matmul(activation, weight_dequant.T)
    return output
